# Helper functions
```{r helpers}
# Cumulative PG gene lists: for each threshold, the smallest set of top genes
# whose cumulative score (in %) reaches that threshold. NULL if never reached.
build_pg_lists <- function(top_genes, thresholds) {
  cum_pct <- cumsum(top_genes) * 100
  lapply(thresholds, function(t) {
    idx <- which(cum_pct >= t)[1]
    if (is.na(idx)) NULL else names(top_genes)[seq_len(idx)]
  })
}

# Seurat dispersion-ranked HVGs (descending), computed on the given counts
rank_hvgs <- function(counts) {
  so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(counts))
  Idents(so) <- "All_Cells"
  so <- NormalizeData(so, verbose = FALSE)
  so <- FindVariableFeatures(so, selection.method = "dispersion",
                             nfeatures = nrow(counts), verbose = FALSE)  # dispersion = log(variance/mean)
  disp <- so[["RNA"]]@meta.data$vf_disp_data_mvp.dispersion
  names(disp) <- rownames(counts)
  disp[is.na(disp)] <- 0
  names(sort(disp, decreasing = TRUE))
}

# skmeans clustering on a gene set, returns sensitivity
cluster_sensitivity <- function(genes, counts, labels, k, seed) {
  mat <- counts[genes, , drop = FALSE]
  set.seed(seed)
  cl <- skmeans(x = t(log2(mat + 1)), k = k, control = list(verbose = FALSE))$cluster
  sens <- clustSensitivity(cl, labels, as.character(1:k))
  as.numeric(sens[1, 2])
}

# Mean, SD and 95% t-based CI across subsets (columns = thresholds)
summarize_accuracy <- function(acc) {
  n   <- colSums(!is.na(acc))
  m   <- colMeans(acc, na.rm = TRUE)
  s   <- apply(acc, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  moe <- qt(0.975, df = pmax(n - 1, 1)) * s / sqrt(n)
  moe[n < 2] <- NA_real_
  data.frame(n_subsets = n, mean_accuracy = m, sd_accuracy = s,
             ci_lower = m - moe, ci_upper = m + moe)
}

save_plot <- function(p, stem) {
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(stem, ".jpg")), p, device = "jpeg",
         width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT, units = "in", dpi = PLOT_DPI)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(stem, ".tif")), p, device = "tiff",
         width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT, units = "in", dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         compression = "lzw")
}
```

# Tabula Muris Lung
## Read in the dataset
```{r read-in-data}
input_file <- here(INPUT_DIR, "TabulaMuris_Lung_Counts.csv")
truth_file <- here(INPUT_DIR, "TabulaMuris_Lung_Labels.csv")
name       <- "TabulaMuris_Lung"

csv_path  <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(name, "_PG_HVG_Union_Bootstrapping_Sensitivity.csv"))
plot_stem <- paste0(name, "_PG_HVG_Union_Bootstrapping_Sensitivity")

count_matrix <- read.csv(input_file, check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1)

# True labels, matched to count_matrix columns by cell name
full_true_labels <- read.csv(truth_file, check.names = FALSE)
label_levels <- unique(full_true_labels$label)
true_labels_vector <- setNames(
  as.numeric(factor(full_true_labels$label, levels = label_levels)),
  full_true_labels$cell
)[colnames(count_matrix)]
names(true_labels_vector) <- colnames(count_matrix)
if (anyNA(true_labels_vector)) warning("Some cells in count_matrix have no true label.")
k_cls <- max(true_labels_vector, na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Subsample 80% of cells, run gene selection + skmeans on each subset
```{r subsampled-gene-selection-and-clustering}
thresholds  <- seq(10, 50, by = 2)
n_subsets   <- 5
subset_frac <- 0.8
seeds       <- c(12345, 54672, 44182, 72198, 98230)

if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
  message("Found existing ", csv_path, " -- skipping computation and loading it.")
  plot_df1 <- read.csv(csv_path)
} else {
  all_cells   <- colnames(count_matrix)
  subset_size <- floor(subset_frac * length(all_cells))
  n_thr       <- length(thresholds)

  # rows = subsets, columns = thresholds
  acc_pg <- acc_hvg <- acc_union <- matrix(NA_real_, n_subsets, n_thr)
  ngenes_pg <- ngenes_union <- matrix(NA_real_, n_subsets, n_thr)

  for (r in seq_len(n_subsets)) {
    message("Subset ", r, " of ", n_subsets)
    set.seed(seeds[r])
    cell_subset <- sample(all_cells, subset_size)
    sub_counts  <- count_matrix[, cell_subset]
    sub_labels  <- true_labels_vector[cell_subset]

    # Gene selection on this subset only
    set.seed(seeds[r])
    pg_res <- principalgenes(sub_counts, cut = 1,
                             filters = c("riboFilter", "mtFilter", "gmFilter", "rikFilter", "dotFilter"))
    pg_lists   <- build_pg_lists(pg_res$top_genes, thresholds)
    hvg_ranked <- rank_hvgs(sub_counts)

    for (j in seq_len(n_thr)) {
      pg_genes <- pg_lists[[j]]
      if (is.null(pg_genes)) {
        message("  threshold ", thresholds[j], " not reached in subset ", r)
        next
      }
      hvg_genes   <- hvg_ranked[seq_along(pg_genes)]   # size-matched to PG
      union_genes <- union(pg_genes, hvg_genes)

      ngenes_pg[r, j]    <- length(pg_genes)
      ngenes_union[r, j] <- length(union_genes)

      acc_pg[r, j]    <- cluster_sensitivity(pg_genes,    sub_counts, sub_labels, k_cls, seeds[r])
      acc_hvg[r, j]   <- cluster_sensitivity(hvg_genes,   sub_counts, sub_labels, k_cls, seeds[r])
      acc_union[r, j] <- cluster_sensitivity(union_genes, sub_counts, sub_labels, k_cls, seeds[r])
    }
  }

  mean_ng_pg    <- colMeans(ngenes_pg,    na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_ng_union <- colMeans(ngenes_union, na.rm = TRUE)

  make_block <- function(acc, metric, mean_ng, label) {
    cbind(data.frame(thresholds = thresholds, metric = metric,
                     mean_num_genes = mean_ng,
                     label_val = if (label) round(mean_ng) else NA),
          summarize_accuracy(acc))
  }

  plot_df1 <- bind_rows(
    make_block(acc_pg,    "PG_sensitivity",  mean_ng_pg,    TRUE),
    make_block(acc_hvg,   "HVG_sensitivity", mean_ng_pg,    FALSE),
    make_block(acc_union, "PG_HVG_Union",    mean_ng_union, TRUE)
  )

  write.csv(plot_df1, csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
}

plot_df1$metric <- factor(plot_df1$metric,
                          levels = c("PG_sensitivity", "HVG_sensitivity", "PG_HVG_Union"))
```

## Plot mean clustering sensitivity vs cumulative score with 95% CI
```{r plot-subsampled-accuracy}
show_legend <- SHOW_LEGEND

p <- ggplot(plot_df1, aes(x = thresholds, y = mean_accuracy, color = metric)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.5) +

  # PG labels (mean # genes across subsets)
  geom_text(
    data = subset(plot_df1, metric == "PG_sensitivity"),
    aes(label = label_val),
    color = "#1BB7D8", vjust = +2, size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE,
    family = FONT_FAMILY, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Union labels (mean # genes across subsets)
  geom_text(
    data = subset(plot_df1, metric == "PG_HVG_Union"),
    aes(label = label_val),
    color = "darkgreen", vjust = -2, size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE,
    family = FONT_FAMILY, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    method.args = list(span = 1, degree = 1, surface = "direct"),
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Cumulative GPS (%)", y = "Clustering Sensitivity", title = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c("PG_sensitivity", "HVG_sensitivity", "PG_HVG_Union"),
    values = c(
      "PG_sensitivity"  = "#1BB7D8",
      "HVG_sensitivity" = "#E55B1E",
      "PG_HVG_Union"    = "#2C9F45"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "PG_sensitivity"  = "Principal Genes",
      "HVG_sensitivity" = "Seurat's HVG",
      "PG_HVG_Union"    = "HVG_PG_Union"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  theme(
    legend.position             = if (show_legend) "inside" else "none",
    legend.position.inside      = LEGEND_POSITION,
    legend.justification.inside = LEGEND_POSITION,
    legend.box.margin           = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
    legend.title                = element_blank(),
    legend.background           = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), colour = NA)
  )

print(p)
save_plot(p, plot_stem)
```
